description: fs: rewinddir + O_EXCL (M6-A, tcc-prep). userspace/ctests/musl_direxcl.c: rewinddir restarts a snapshot-backed directory (opendir snapshots via native Readdir, cursor lives in the snapshot, dir->fd=-1), and open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL) atomically creates — succeeding when absent, failing EEXIST when present. opendir capacity was also raised 256->1024 (kernel MAX_USER_DIRENTS=1024); not directly markable here (/app has few entries), correct by construction. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_direxcl_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 220 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: rewinddir reset the snapshot cursor so a second pass saw the same entry count
open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL) on an existing path failed with EEXIST

forbidden.why: exclusive create of an absent path failed
exclusive create of an existing path did not return EEXIST
